scripts.export:release: node scripts/with-production-public-env.mjs expo export --platform android --platform ios
scripts.build:android:release:
node -e "console.error('Local Gradle Android release builds are intentionally disabled.

Use the EAS Play Store build path instead:
  pnpm play:android:build

The checked-in Android Gradle project still uses the debug keystore for its release build type. Until local upload-keystore signing is wired and verified, this command fails closed so a debug-signed AAB cannot be mistaken for a Play-ready artifact.'); process.exit(1)"
scripts.build:android:playstore: pnpm run assert:production-env && node scripts/with-production-public-env.mjs npx eas-cli build --platform android --profile production
scripts.build:ios:simulator: node scripts/with-production-public-env.mjs xcodebuild -workspace ios/LinkDish.xcworkspace -scheme LinkDish -configuration Release -sdk iphonesimulator -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' build
scripts.export:ios:testflight: node scripts/with-testflight-env.mjs expo export --clear --platform ios --output-dir dist-ios-testflight && node scripts/assert-ios-release-export.mjs
scripts.build:ios:testflight: node scripts/check-ios-release.mjs && node scripts/sync-ios-release-env.mjs && npx eas-cli build --platform ios --profile testflight --clear-cache
